newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint steady vs basket, eases vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint steady vs basket, eases vs dollar.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed steady against the central bank basket on Thursday but eased slightly versus the dollar, tracking the dollar/mark cross, dealers said.
The forint remained at the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid) all day and finished at 184.50/55 against the dollar, compared with 184.25 at opening.

Traders said that the forint which usually trades close to the NBH bid, but was at levels up to 50 pips below the resistance level in the past few weeks, returned to the NBH bid on Wednesday and was likely to stay there.

They said the concerns of foreign investors over the Czech government's fight for stabilising the crown had caused the forint's weakening, but the Hungarian currency was likely to stay at the NBH bid now that it returned to the resistance level.
"But foreigners did not show a strong interest to pull out their money," said Attila Behan of ING Bank. "It was natural that we went back to the (NBH) bid after all."
